topology_reasoning: The reference is a planar closed-loop photonic component. A broad outer racetrack/oval guide wraps around the footprint, with its two side turns joining upper and lower horizontal sections. Inside it are two shorter, parallel horizontal guide sections; their center regions are interrupted by repeated rectangular clearances, producing the distinctive paired window pattern. I model the outer loop with straight sections plus smooth 180-degree bends and the inner sections with straight primitives and rectangular frame/clearance assemblies. Function-defining knobs are guide width, outer loop radius/straight length, inner-guide vertical separation, inner straight length, and the central window dimensions and spacing. All geometry is assembled from GDSFactory paths, extrusions, straights, bends, and rectangles on layer (1, 0).
